fusions.name: Surface Skip
fusions.desc: Spits a bead of pond water at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. It then skips to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Slick Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays slick water 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything in the cone, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it [Leaden] for 5 seconds, which lowers its dodge.

fusions.name: Out of the Hand
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. Using it increases your movement speed by 15% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Tadpole Wake
fusions.desc: A bonded shoal of tadpoles fights beside you, nipping enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds and slowing each by 15% for 2 seconds.
